entries.def:
ἄτιμος, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX: Isa.3.5 (קָלָה ni.), Isa.53.3 (בָּזָה), Job.30.4, 8 (שֵׁם בְּלִי), שֵׁם בְּלִי), Wis.5.1-23, Sir.1.1-30 * ;] 
without honour, dishonoured, despised: Mat.13.57, Mrk.6.4, 1Co.4.10; comp., 1Co.12.23.†
(AS)

ἀτιμόω, -ῶ
(ἄτιμος), [in LXX chiefly for בָּזָה ;] 
= ἀτιμάζω, to dishonour, treat with indignity: Mrk.12.4, Rec.†
(AS)

ἀτμίς, -ίδος, ἡ 
[in LXX for עָנַן, תִּמֹּר, etc. ;] 
vapour: Jas.4.14 ἀ. καπνοῦ, Act.2.19 (LXX).†
(AS)

ἄ-τομος, -ον
(τέμνω), [in Sm.: Isa.54.8 (MM, see word) * ;] 
indivisible; of time, ἄτομον, a moment: ἐν ἄ., 1Co.15.52.†
(AS)

ἄ-τοπος, -ον
(τόπος), [in LXX: Job.4.8; 11.11, Pro.30.20, al., for אָוֶן, etc. ;] 
__1. out of place, not befitting. 
__2. marvellous, strange (of symptoms, Hipp.): Act.28.6 hence, in late Greek, with ethical sense, 
__3. improper, unrighteous (so in LXX, and for exx. from π., see M, Th., l.with; MM, see word): Luk.23.41, Act.25.5, 2Th.3.2.†
(AS)

Ἀτταλία (Rec. -άλεια), -υς, ἡ 
Attalia, a city of Pamphylia: Act.14.25.†
(AS)

αὐγάζω
(αὐγή), [in LXX: Lev.13.24-28, 38; 14.56 (בֹּהֶרֶת) Lev.13.39 (כֵּהֶה)* ;] 
__1. Trans. (cl.), to irradiate. 
__2. Intrans. 
__(a) (poët.), to see clearly (so perh. 2 Co, l.with; MM, see word) 
__(b) as in LXX, to shine forth: 2Co.4.4 (cf. δι-, κατ-αυγάζω).†
(AS)

αὐγή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Isa.59.9 (נְגֹהָה), 2Ma.12.9 * ;] 
__1. brightness 
__2. Later (as in MGr.; MM, see word), daylight, dawn: Act.20.11 (Cremer, 118).†
SYN.: φέγγος (see Thayer, s. φ.; DB, iii, 44a; Tr., Syn., § xlvi). (AS)

Αὔγουστος, -ου, ὁ
(Lat.), Augustus, the Roman Emperor: Luk.2.1 (cf. Σεβαστός; and see MM, see word).†
(AS)

αὐθάδης, -ες
(αὐτος, ἥδομαι), [in LXX: Gen.49.3, 7 (עַז), Pro.21.24 (יָהִיר)* ;] 
self-pleasing, arrogant: Tit.1.7, 2Pe.2.10 (Cremer, 654).†
SYN.: φίλαυτος (see Tr., Syn., § xciii) (AS)
